title: Law to co-name seven streets and public places
summary: This bill would add seven honorary street co-names across Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island and Brooklyn, including Champion's Plaza honoring the 2026 NBA champion Knicks and Little Panama recognizing Brooklyn's Panamanian community, plus several honoring individuals who died between 2012 and 2024. It also repeals five sections of a 2026 local law and one section of a 2020 local law related to prior street namings.
